title: Hard-code ActivePieces webhook URL (remove env-var dependency)

requirements.text: Hard-code the ActivePieces webhook endpoint URL in the frontend code so the app works without configuring the VITE_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable. Use this exact URL: https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync

quotes: Do you want me to update your app so that the webhook URL is hard‑coded into the frontend code instead of using an environment variable?

acceptanceCriteria: If VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is not set at build time, uploads and Ask AI requests still call https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync
If VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is set, the app behavior is documented and consistent (either it overrides the hard-coded URL or it is ignored), and no runtime UI is required to configure it

requirements.text: Remove/disable any UI warnings, prompts, or help panels that instruct the user to configure VITE_WEBHOOK_URL (e.g., messages like “Webhook URL is not configured...”). The dashboard should not display any webhook setup banner in live mode.

quotes: in this window i cannot see environment variable. please add the url by yourself

acceptanceCriteria: When the app loads in authenticated mode, there is no visible banner or alert telling the user to set VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
No UI flow exists that asks the user to paste/save/clear a webhook URL at runtime (e.g., via localStorage overrides or a setup panel)

requirements.text: Ensure file upload and Ask AI flows no longer fail with an error that specifically references missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL. Error messages (when they occur) should reflect actual network/response failures, not configuration instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: With the hard-coded URL enabled, uploading a valid file does not throw an error about missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
With the hard-coded URL enabled, Ask AI does not throw an error about missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
If the webhook responds with non-OK status or invalid payload, the user sees a clear error describing the request/response failure (not env-var setup steps)

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Adding a new backend service or storing webhook URLs in the Motoko canister state
Adding a runtime settings screen to manage webhook URLs
Integrating third-party auth beyond Internet Identity
